sampling.jump_threshold: training-only 95th percentile of future maximum absolute midpoint excursion

corrected_features.near_touch: minimum displayed bid/ask quantity within 1, 2, 5, and 10 bps, sign-oriented as scarcity
corrected_features.sweep: mean absolute buy/sell VWAP displacement for fixed 1, 3, and 5 BTC market orders
corrected_features.convexity: change in sweep-cost slope from 1-3 BTC to 3-5 BTC
corrected_features.recovery: current recovery from the trailing 60-second minimum in 5-bps minimum-side depth, sign-oriented as slow recovery
corrected_features.small_trade_amplification: volume of individual trades no larger than 0.1 BTC divided by 5-bps minimum-side depth
corrected_features.flow_cost_interaction: absolute signed trade volume multiplied by 5-BTC sweep cost

targeted_tests.orientation: higher feature value means higher predicted future excursion
targeted_tests.dependence_control: 10-minute test blocks and 1000 deterministic block-bootstrap resamples
targeted_tests.support_rule: positive Spearman rho and strictly positive 95% block-bootstrap interval

interpretation: One day can reject this implementation but cannot establish a deployable alpha. A pass requires another untouched whole-day replication. A failure closes this measurement-correction branch.
